tool_input.command:
export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR='/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec105/fx' && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && export TMPPREFIX=/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec105/tmp/zsh && PLUGIN_ROOT="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/plugins/system-spec-harness" && ls -la system-spec system-spec/retrieval-evidence && 
python3 -B "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/validate-coverage-matrix.py" --matrix $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/system-spec/spec-state.json --require-complete; echo g1=$?
python3 -B "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/validate-source-citation.py" --targets $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/system-spec/spec-state.json --references $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/system-spec/fetched-references.json --repo-root $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; echo g2=$?
python3 -B "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/validate-design-knowledge-refs.py" --matrix $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/system-spec/spec-state.json --repo-root $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; echo g3=$?
